SSCU-Net **Official implementation of “Flattened and simplified SSCU-Net: exploring the convolution potential for medical image segmentation.”** [](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11227-024-06357-6) [](https://www.python.org/) [](https://pytorch.org/) [](LICENSE) Overview SSCU-Net (Shallow Super Convolution U-shaped Net) is a flattened, lightweight convolutional network for medical image segmentation. The main implementation follows a two-layer U-shaped design and combines: - the multi-branch Super Convolution Block (`SuperConvBlock`, or SC-Block); - a spatial/directional convolution path implemented as `DirectionalConvPath`; - custom downsampling and upsampling mechanisms implemented as `DownSample` and `UpSample`. The accompanying paper describes the sampling mechanisms as Feature Enhanced Downsample (FED) and Feature Resolution Upsample (FRU)
